caveats.linear_probe_not_top1: See accuracy_column. The probe is fitted on 5000 images for 1000 classes.
caveats.int4_is_simulated: INT4 is the prototype's per-channel quantize/dequantize round-trip in fp32, not a 4-bit kernel. bitsandbytes NF4 is CUDA-only and absent on this ROCm image, so real INT4 is not available on this hardware. The column measures the accuracy cost of 4-bit weight rounding and nothing about its speed or memory.
caveats.one_seed: One training seed. It cannot estimate training-seed variance, which on ViT-B/16 was SAL's largest term (sd up to 17.55pp in exp27).
caveats.masked_rows_keep_all_params: Every row but the -sliced ones masks heads rather than removing them, so the parameter count and the arithmetic are unchanged and the latency columns should show no gain.
